worldcombat.skill.petalblizzard.summary: Whirls up a blizzard of petals: the first gust draws the petals and foes around it inward, the following gusts hurl them out, and every gust cuts those inside the ring. Step out of the ring and the cuts stop. The petals thrown out fade soon after they land and leave nothing behind. Cyclone is narrower and heavier with one extra gust.
worldcombat.skill.petalblizzard.use.0: Cut a whole ring at once and throw them off
worldcombat.skill.petalblizzard.use.1: Pull a charger in, then hurl it out
worldcombat.skill.petalblizzard.use.3: Swirl a layer of scattering petals around your feet
worldcombat.skill.petalblizzard.descript: Each gust deals about %1$s physical damage to every foe in the ring, %2$s gusts in all; stay inside and you are cut once per gust, step out and the cuts stop. The whole storm can cut at most %3$s foes. The target's defence, type and crit are settled on each hit.
The storm reaches %1$s blocks and throws one gust every %2$s s.
The first gust pulls a target %1$s blocks toward the caster; later gusts hurl it %2$s blocks outward.
It lifts petals; the ones thrown out fade soon after they land and leave nothing behind.
Cyclone on: the storm is about ×0.72 wide, each gust about ×1.28 stronger, one extra gust, and both the pull and the hurl are stronger, but wind-up +3 and cooldown +8 ticks.
Cyclone off (wide storm): the storm is about ×1.15 as wide and each gust about ×0.94, with a faster wind-up and a 2-tick shorter cooldown, for covering a small patch or chasing scattered foes.
worldcombat.skill.petalblizzard.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s, with a %5$s s cooldown afterwards.
worldcombat.skill.petalblizzard.growth.0: At level %1$s each gust rises to %2$s, the storm to %3$s blocks, and the pull to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.petalblizzard.preferen: On: the storm narrows to about ×0.72, each gust about ×1.28 stronger, one extra gust, with stronger pull and hurl but a longer wind-up and cooldown, for gathering a cluster and slamming it. Off (wide storm): about ×1.15 as wide with lighter gusts and faster recovery, for covering a small patch or chasing scattered foes.
The companion only considers Petal Blizzard when a threat is this close; lower it to whirl only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
At least this many visible foes must stand within its consider distance before it whirls; raise it for surrounded-only use, set it to 1 to whirl at a single target.
